props.seoDescription: Meet Mark – founder of Health Renovation and wholistic practitioner with 27+ years of experience in Kinesiology, Homeopathy, Massage, Reiki, Life Coaching and MRT-Detox.

props.heading: About Mark
props.subtitle: Healing with heart, insight, and 27+ years of experience.

props.heading: Hi, I'm Mark
props.body:
I've been practicing wholistic health for over 27 years, and I still find this work profoundly meaningful. Every client who walks through the door brings a unique story – a complex interplay of physical symptoms, emotional patterns, life history, and unmet needs.

My approach is simple: I listen. I listen to your words, your body, and the deeper signals that emerge through techniques like kinesiology and muscle testing. From there, I work with you – not on you – to find a path that supports real, lasting change.

Over the years, I've trained extensively in Kinesiology, Homeopathy, Massage Therapy, Reiki, Life Coaching, and Matrix Regeneration Therapy (MRT-Detox). Each modality adds a different dimension to the care I can offer – and together, they allow me to meet clients wherever they're at.

Whether you're managing chronic pain, exhausted by stress, navigating an emotional challenge, or simply feeling like you've lost yourself somewhere along the way – I'm here to help you find your way back.
props.quote: "Your health is not a luxury. It's the foundation of everything you want to do and be. Put yourself first."

items.title: Whole Person
items.desc: I treat the whole person, not isolated symptoms. Physical, emotional, and energetic dimensions are all considered.

items.title: Personalised
items.desc: No two clients are alike. Every treatment plan is uniquely tailored to your specific needs, history, and goals.

items.title: Gentle & Safe
items.desc: All therapies are gentle, non-invasive, and safe – designed to work with your body, not against it.

items.title: Informed
items.desc: I explain clearly what I'm doing and why. You are always in control, fully informed, and able to ask questions.

props.heading: Ready to Take the First Step?
props.subtitle: Call or text Mark for a free discovery conversation.
